_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate and failed bottom rhyme keep the phase pinned inside 39-46 until a named breaker (ETF/CVD revival or funding-flip liquidation) appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: both lock Anxiety now; analyst explicitly HOLDs the rung, narrative offers no forward call to agree or split with
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, phase score remains 39-46, funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Score exits Anxiety by 2+ pts (up on ETF+CVD follow-through, or down on crowded-long liquidation and negative funding)
